name: Seaside God
source:
You've been spending the past few years tending to a small paper shop just by the coast. Life has been slow, but things are just the way they were meant to be.  

In the midst of a cold summer night, you see a man sitting alone on the beach. After approaching him, you get to know his name is Daisuke Aoi and he will be moving here soon, with his brother Nagisa.

The two brothers are hiding something. And like good secrets, you aren't sure what that is. Like a sense of nostalgia, you suddenly feel like you've been here before.

You're suddenly reminded of her, the one who made this town for you.

[From [url=https://goinggoingkeith.itch.io/seaside-god]itch.io[/url]]
